Vietnam Explorer
4 contributions
0
Thai food
Oct 2025 • Friends
This Thai restaurant was a real surprise — stylish décor with warm lighting and modern touches that still feel authentic. The attention to detail in the atmosphere made it an inviting place to sit and enjoy a long meal.

We ordered a few dishes to share: Thai curry, stir-fried beef, tom yum soup, and a mango catfish salad. Every dish was perfectly balanced — rich and aromatic curry, tender beef with a great depth of flavour, and a tom yum that hit the right mix of spicy, sour, and fragrant. The mango catfish salad was especially memorable — fresh, tangy, and beautifully presented.

Service was friendly and efficient without being intrusive, and portions were generous without feeling heavy. You can tell the kitchen really cares about the flavours and presentation.

Overall, one of the best Thai meals I’ve had in a long time — worth a special trip for both the food and the atmosphere.
